name: Toptier Topology
description: Determines efficient page, layout, component, state, interaction, and responsive topology before or during web application scaffolding.

routing.trigger: Use for new web application planning, frontend restructuring, component architecture, page topology, design-system-aware scaffolding, or layout hierarchy decisions.
routing.boundary: Do not invoke for isolated cosmetic edits, trivial copy changes, or backend-only work where frontend topology is unaffected.
invoke_conditions: new frontend or web application architecture is being planned
component placement or reuse boundaries need to be decided
block_conditions: simple bug fix with no topology impact
